note: written by the template's migrate/z6.py, then pointed at public sources for this repo (2026-11-10): read by pc/z6_setup.py and pc/engines.py

sources.about: the public sources pc/engines.py makes <root>\engines\<dir> from (the pins are edge-llm-bench windows/engine-pins.json's); every .exe / .dll is then checked against dirs (the bench's record of the files the cells ran)

litert.about: LiteRT-LM publishes no Windows binary of its CLI (the release page; the PyPI wheel litert-lm-api 0.19.0 for Windows holds litert-lm.dll, no CLI): the tag is built with edge-llm-bench's script, as the cells' engine was. The tools it compiles (rebuilt) get other bytes than the record; the tag's prebuilt DLLs (prebuilt: their git LFS sha256s at the tag are the record's) and the wheel's two DirectX shader compiler DLLs (the record's sha256s too) keep theirs
litert.label: v0.19.0-model-zoo

openvino.about: the OpenVINO runtime the LiteRT-LM build fetched (edge-llm-bench windows/README.md, the NPU row): <output_base>\external\intel_openvino\openvino\runtime\bin\intel64\Release\* and its tbb\bin\*
